name: John Quinn Stang
locations: South Whitehall Township, Lehigh County, Pennsylvania
sources: Obituary of Justin Kyle Stang, Morning Call, Allentown, Feb 2004 (Legacy.com)
Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Son of Bernard J. and Catherine Joan (Quinn) Stang: his son Justin's 2004 obituary names Bernard J. and Catherine J. (Quinn) Stang as Justin's paternal grandparents. Possibly the cousin "Quinn" of Barbara's memoir, who is listed separately from a cousin John. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 413]
